Find the calls that new data or new bands put in question

Source: R/mortality_store.R
reconcile_mortality.Rd

Compares the reviewer's calls in x$mortality with bands computed after the calls were made, for example after a new year of detections was added and detect_mortality() was run again. An animal needs another look when it has no call and sits in the dead or review band; when it was called alive and is now in the dead band; when it was called dead_or_shed and is now in the alive band, or has detections more than moved_km from its last position on or before the death date; when its call is uncertain; or when a dead_or_shed call has no date. Calls are not changed: the reviewer makes the new call on the cards, and apply_mortality_calls() brings it back.

Usage

reconcile_mortality(x, bands, moved_km = 1)

Arguments

x

A detset with calls from apply_mortality_calls().

bands

The result of detect_mortality() on x as it is now.

moved_km

Movement after the death date, in km. A detection after the death date counts as movement when it lies more than moved_km from the station that heard the animal last on or before that date. One finite positive number; 1 km by default. The bands carry their own sites_km, the distance detect_mortality() uses to group stations into sites; reconcile_mortality() does not read it.

Value

x with x$reconcile, a data frame of every animal in the bands: animal_id, call, death_date, band, needs_review and reason; and a new log row that counts each reason.

See also

review_mortality(), which can build cards for these animals.

Examples

study <- detqc_example
dets <- detset(study$detections, study$deployments, study$animals)
calls <- data.frame(animal_id = c("ST-02", "ST-03"),
                    call = c("alive", "uncertain"))
calls_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
utils::write.csv(calls, calls_file, row.names = FALSE)
dets <- reconcile_mortality(apply_mortality_calls(dets, calls_file), detect_mortality(dets))
dets$reconcile[dets$reconcile$needs_review, c("animal_id", "call", "band", "reason")]
#>   animal_id      call   band                       reason
#> 1     ST-01      <NA> review no call, dead or review band
#> 2     ST-03 uncertain review             called uncertain
#> 3     ST-04      <NA> review no call, dead or review band
